title: Learning Composable Chains-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2505.22635v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A common approach for teaching large language models (LLMs) to reason is to train on chain-of-thought (CoT) traces of in-distribution reasoning problems, but such annotated data is costly to obtain for every problem of interest. We want reasoning models to generalize beyond their training distribution, and ideally to generalize compositionally: combine atomic reasoning skills to solve harder, unseen reasoning tasks. We take a step towards compositional generalization of reasoning skills when addressing a target compositional task that has no labeled CoT data. We find that simply training models on CoT data of atomic tasks leads to limited generalization, but minimally modifying CoT formats of constituent atomic tasks to be composable can lead to improvements. translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.22635v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：教大型语言模型（LLM）进行推理的一种常见方法是在同分布推理问题的思维链（CoT）轨迹上进行训练，但对于每个感兴趣的问题，这类标注数据的获取成本很高。我们希望推理模型能够泛化到训练分布之外，并且理想情况下能够实现组合泛化：将原子推理技能组合起来，以解决更难的、未见过的推理任务。我们在处理一个没有标注CoT数据的目标组合任务时，朝着推理技能的组合泛化迈出了一步。我们发现，仅在原子任务的CoT数据上训练模型只能带来有限的泛化能力，但通过对组成原子任务的CoT格式进行最小程度的修改使其可组合，则可以带来改进。我们可以使用可组合CoT数据在原子任务上训练“原子CoT”模型，并通过多任务学习或模型合并将它们结合起来，从而在目标任务上获得更好的零样本性能。
tldr: 该论文提出将原子任务的思维链格式最小修改为可组合形式，并通过多任务学习或模型合并来组合“原子CoT”模型，从而在目标任务没有标注CoT数据的情况下实现推理技能的组合泛化，提升对更难的未见任务的零样本推理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that minimally modifying the CoT formats of atomic tasks to be composable and combining "atomic CoT" models via multitask learning or model merging enables compositional generalization of reasoning skills, achieving better zero-shot performance on harder, unseen tasks without requiring labeled CoT data for the target task.
